searchText: Yes, correct. I'm planning to update things a bit to start targeting v0.5.0 which was released some days ago. Trying to find some time to start with that so we have runs for the latest release. we pass v0.5.0 but it's not in the main branch yet so, those are on v0.4.1? Current last run in the dashboard are still v0.4.1 yes. Reg including Nethermind, I would prefer to start with executionWitness compliance rather than the guest program until we publish the rubric for guest programs (so added new ones is coherent). Does nethermind has a branch for glamsterdam-devnet-6 with a engine_newPayloadWithWitness ? yes, it does must be [this](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/tree/glamsterdam-devnet-6) thanks! will try to include when i can resume this work to update to v0.5.0 so which json should i update now? or you mean you'll take care? Let me take care to try some thing locally first, since running in CI is very slow. I can ping you whenever I have some news reg this or any questions 🙏 thanks I see that glamsterdam-devnet-7 is planned to be launched soon and prob will be the last devnet. Maybe I'll make a release soon on top of that new one and we can wait for that one to run tests in dashboard (i.e. skip v0.5.0 (which is devnet-6) as target for new runs)
